<!--
FDIC-BRC / JFQA revision v4 (PDF-comment round, 2026-08-07).
§1 "Other measures" for the repurchasing-insurance point: combined insured
   brokered + reciprocal outcome; extensive margin (any reciprocal).
§2 SVB-vulnerability cross-section: CECL Adj on 2022Q4 exposure measures,
   univariate + joint. Expectation: near-zero, tiny R2.
Inputs: panel_smallbank (post-jmcb vintage via fallback).
-->

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(here)

source(here::here("code", "_common.R"))
source(here::here("tracks", "fdic-brc-jfqa-aug2026", "code", "_track_common.R"))

save_tables <- TRUE

panel <- readRDS(latest_track_file("panel_smallbank"))
setDT(panel)

dt_w <- panel[abs(qtrs_since) < 12]
dt_w[, post := ifelse(qtrs_since > 0, 1, 0)]
dt_w[, D_DT := as.factor(as.Date(D_DT))]

setFixest_fml(
  ..reg_dummy = ~ post * high_cecl_equity,
  ..reg_cont  = ~ post * cecl_equity,
  ..controls  = ~ log_total_assets_l1 + equity_assets_l1 + int_expense_assets_l1,
  ..fe = ~ ID_RSSD + D_DT
)

dict_r <- c(covariate_labels_dict, "(Intercept)" = "Constant",
            "ins_wholesale_assets" = "Ins. Brokered + Reciprocal/Assets (\\%)",
            "has_reciprocal" = "Any Reciprocal (0/1)",
            "unreal_loss_assets_22q4" = "Unrealized Sec. Loss/Assets (\\%)",
            "unins_dep_share_22q4" = "Unins. Dep./Deposits (\\%)",
            "brokered_share_22q4" = "Brokered Dep./Deposits (\\%)",
            "log_ta_22q4" = "log(Assets)",
            "equity_assets_22q4" = "Equity/Assets (\\%)",
            "cre_loans_share_22q4" = "CRE/Loans (\\%)")
order_did_tbl <- c("Post x CECL Adj", "Post x High CECL")
```

## §1 Combined insured-wholesale funding DiD

```{r}
dt_w[, ins_wholesale_assets := brokered_ins_assets + reciprocal_assets]
dt_w[, has_reciprocal := as.integer(reciprocal_assets > 0)]

r1 <- list(
  feols(ins_wholesale_assets ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(ins_wholesale_assets ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(has_reciprocal ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(has_reciprocal ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)
cat("\n================ §1 INSURED WHOLESALE (combined) ================\n")
etable(r1, dict = dict_r, order = order_did_tbl)
export_track_tbl(r1, "tbl_ins_wholesale", dict_r, order_did_tbl)
```

## §2 SVB-exposure cross-section

```{r}
cs <- unique(dt_w[!is.na(cecl_equity),
                  .(ID_RSSD, cecl_equity, unreal_loss_assets_22q4,
                    unins_dep_share_22q4, brokered_share_22q4, log_ta_22q4,
                    equity_assets_22q4, cre_loans_share_22q4)])

# All specifications include log assets and equity/assets as controls.
r2 <- list(
  feols(cecl_equity ~ unreal_loss_assets_22q4 + log_ta_22q4 + equity_assets_22q4, data = cs, vcov = "hetero"),
  feols(cecl_equity ~ unins_dep_share_22q4    + log_ta_22q4 + equity_assets_22q4, data = cs, vcov = "hetero"),
  feols(cecl_equity ~ unreal_loss_assets_22q4 + unins_dep_share_22q4 +
          brokered_share_22q4 + cre_loans_share_22q4 +
          log_ta_22q4 + equity_assets_22q4, data = cs, vcov = "hetero")
)
cat("\n================ §2 SVB EXPOSURE CROSS-SECTION ================\n")
etable(r2, dict = dict_r)
export_track_tbl(r2, "tbl_svb_exposure", dict_r)

cat("\n================ DIAGNOSTICS ================\n")
cat("DiD window rows:", nrow(dt_w), "| banks:", uniqueN(dt_w$ID_RSSD), "\n")
cat("ins_wholesale non-NA:", dt_w[, sum(!is.na(ins_wholesale_assets))], "\n")
cat("Cross-section N:", nrow(cs), "\n")
print(round(cs[, sapply(.SD, function(x) mean(!is.na(x))), .SDcols = -1], 3))
```
